summaryZh: CNDD Lab利用基因组与表观基因组数据研究神经细胞发育和调控，关注DNA甲基化等表观遗传过程如何影响基因表达、神经回路可塑性和衰老。实验室开发适应数据规模与分辨率的计算分析工具和理论模型。
researchQuestions: 神经细胞甲基化模式如何形成并影响基因表达？
methods: 基因组与表观基因组计算分析

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Computational Neural DNA Dynamics Lab (CNDD) at UCSD.
We are affiliated with: UCSD Cognitive Science Halicioğlu Data Science Institute Kavli Institute for Brain and Mind UCSD Neurosciences Graduate Program UCSD Bioinformatics and Systems Biology Program
Epigenetic processes which modulate gene expression are critical for the development, plasticity, and degeneration of neural circuits
Our lab seeks to exploit the full potential of these resources for elucidating developmental and regulatory processes, by creating computational analysis tools and theoretical models
